text:
Priya Nair: FYI we got another billing ticket — project X was charged even though proxying happened from project Y via a delegated SA. The billing shows origin=proxy-service which loses effective-owner attribution.
Sam Whitaker: Ouch. This is the same root cause as the 'origin rewrite' case we saw last month. Proxy sets x-origin to proxy-service and we normalize to that for billing and quotas.
Leo Gonzalez: We normalize for safety (avoid spoofing) but we lost the delegated SA claim. Can we preserve an 'effective_owner' field in our auth-envelope (signed) so downstream systems have reliable attribution?
Rohit Verma: Any new fields must avoid breaking edge gateways and be opt-in. Proposal: add a signed header X-Redwood-Effective-Owner: hmac(id|org|project|sa) and publish the verification key via the auth service.
Ava (Console PM): If we add an effective owner, Console needs to show both "Auth origin" and "Effective owner" in the request inspector and in Billing -> Attribution. PM wants minimal churn to existing dashboards.
Priya Nair: UX ask: show effective-owner as a compact pill with hover to expand to full provenance (org/project/sa, timestamp). Also a flag to toggle which attribution powers billing exports.
Sam Whitaker: Implementation concerns: we need to ensure throttles and quota checks continue to use the immediate request identity (for security) but allow billing/telemetry to use effective-owner for attribution and SLO bucketing.
Leo Gonzalez: Right. Quotas must remain conservative. But for long-term metering (historical daily billing) we can attribute to effective-owner with a signed proof.
Rohit Verma: Sample header format (proto sketch):
```
X-Redwood-Effective-Owner: v1;sig=BASE64SIG;payload=BASE64PAYLOAD
# payload -> {"org":"O123","project":"P456","sa":"SA789","iat":1670000000} (base64)
```
Priya Nair: Security checklist: rotate signing keys, verify in edge proxy, fail closed if signature missing for delegated routes? We should tolerate missing header for external clients.
Ava (Console PM): Console rollout plan: 1) read-only field in inspector behind flag, 2) billing export preview where customers can opt-in for effective-owner attribution, 3) 30d delay then default-on for orgs that consent.
Sam Whitaker: Telemetry: metrics-bot, will emitting both attribution flavors (immediate_origin and effective_owner) double our cardinality?
metrics-bot: Quick estimate: adding effective_owner as a dimension increases cardinality ~18% overall; hot orgs skew more. If we HMAC ids to prefix buckets instead of full strings, estimated delta ~6%.
Leo Gonzalez: Good. Also need to add a migration plan for dashboards: keep legacy series (origin_attributed) and add effective_owner series with v2 suffix so panels don't flip unexpectedly.
Rohit Verma: Operation note: put an internal feature-flag "effective-owner-header" scoped to proxies. Rollout gates: 1) create signing key pair and rotate test keys, 2) enable header emission only for delegated SA flows, 3) enable verification in ingest and start writing effective_owner_* metrics.
Priya Nair: Fail criteria: signing verification errors >0.1% of delegated requests, billing-export mismatch >1% compared to baseline, or ingestion spike >20% for 12h.
Ava (Console PM): I'll draft the Console copy for the toggle and help center doc. Please add a canary ticket and link the runbook.
metrics-bot: Feature flag created: feature.effective_owner_header by Rohit Verma. Canary started us-west-2 @ 2026-03-22T09:04:40Z (10%).
Priya Nair: Awesome. Thanks all — let's sync in the rollout meeting tomorrow to align ops+billing+console.
